packageRules.description: Group every update per top-level directory, which maps 1:1 to an Argo app / namespace (app-of-apps.yaml directory generator).
The 'media' directory is a single Argo app / namespace that aggregates several sub-apps (sonarr, radarr, jellyfin, ...). Group them into one PR.
exportarr (bundled by the TrueCharts *arr charts) advertises a container-registry sourceUrl, so Renovate can't fetch its changelog. Point it at the real GitHub repo.
